items.question: How long does development take?
items.answer: Simple landing page — 3–5 days. OpenCart module — 3–7 days. Store from scratch on OpenCart/Horoshop — from 2 weeks. Exact timelines discussed after the brief.

items.question: What's included in post-launch support?
items.answer: First month — free fixes and consultations. After that — by agreement. We don't disappear after payment.

items.question: Do you work with existing OpenCart/Horoshop stores?
items.answer: Yes, that's most of our work. We take a store in any condition — finalize, fix, integrate.

items.question: How does payment work?
items.answer: 50% upfront, 50% after delivery. For large projects — milestone-based payments.

items.question: What if I need something non-standard?
items.answer: Write on Telegram — we'll discuss. We've done integrations with Vapi, Binotel, SalesDrive, KeyCRM. Most likely we already know how.
